profile.description: Scaled resident vocabulary/logits projection:80 FP16 inputs to512 FP16 logits with full reduction and every replicated output checked. No sampling, native model dimensions or model TPS.

memory.scope: bin/*.elf program objects; not union of all ELF loads or physical area

research.hypothesis: For fixed hidden width80 and vocabulary widths512/1024, combine literal expansion of all20 local FP16 FMA terms with bank-offset weight storage and aligned accumulators. Reduce callback/bank overhead in the complete resident GEMV including reduction. The local-row assert prevents accidental use at other hidden widths.
research.falsification: Reject any skipped term, warmup/timed repetition or reduction, changed FP16 precision/grid/timing ABI, six-case output or shutdown failure, less than1.05x baseline speedup, memory growth above1.10x, failed fresh pairing or a slower outcome than the strongest qualified variant. Both output widths must qualify before a suite-wide claim.
